title: One library, six neighbourhoods
question: How do local branches and shared technology deliver one regional library service?
summary: Thirty workplaces across six neighbourhoods connect lending, learning, stock and delivery. Five shared applications support them, with a common runtime, database and gateway.

sources.title: Regional library service — example operating brief

entities.label: Northbank Welcome
entities.description: Welcomes readers, checks requests and connects them to branch services.
entities.constraint: Staff check the collection before promising a pickup.

entities.label: Northbank Collection
entities.description: Maintains the lending collection and prepares reserved books.
entities.constraint: A reservation is ready only after the book is located.

entities.label: Northbank Learning
entities.description: Runs reading groups and digital learning sessions.
entities.constraint: Session places and facilitator availability determine the programme.

entities.label: Northbank Book store
entities.description: Receives, sorts and stores books moving through the regional collection.
entities.constraint: Each transfer needs an identified destination branch.

entities.label: Northbank Delivery
entities.description: Plans inter-branch deliveries and records arrival.
entities.constraint: Branch staff confirm receipt before a book becomes ready for pickup.

entities.label: Shared catalogue
entities.description: Lists titles and the branch holding each copy.
entities.constraint: Branches update holdings after each transfer.

entities.label: Reservations
entities.description: Tracks a reader’s request from ordering to pickup.
entities.constraint: A request remains pending until a copy is assigned.

entities.label: Membership
entities.description: Maintains membership records used by the front desks.
entities.constraint: Staff resolve unmatched reader records before lending.

entities.label: Delivery planning
entities.description: Groups prepared transfers into delivery runs.
entities.constraint: Planning uses the branch destination and ready status.

entities.label: Reader notices
entities.description: Sends a pickup notice after the receiving branch confirms the book.
entities.constraint: A pending transfer must not trigger a ready notice.

entities.label: Shared runtime
entities.description: Runs the shared library services.
entities.constraint: Service availability depends on this runtime.

entities.label: Library records
entities.description: Stores catalogue, membership and reservation records.
entities.constraint: Services need consistent updates when books move.

entities.label: Message gateway
entities.description: Connects notices and delivery updates to external endpoints.
entities.constraint: Delivery acknowledgements return through the gateway.

scenarios.label: A reader crosses neighbourhoods
scenarios.summary: Local help, a borrowed book and a group in Riverside.
scenarios.condition: Northbank has the chosen book; the Riverside reading group is open.
scenarios.outcome: The reader reaches the Riverside learning team with a book from Northbank.

steps.title: Find the collection
steps.text: The welcome team directs the reader to the Northbank collection.

steps.title: Join another neighbourhood
steps.text: The reader takes the connecting streets to the Riverside learning centre and joins the group.

scenarios.label: A book from another branch
scenarios.summary: A reservation becomes a delivered book and a pickup notice.
scenarios.condition: The local branch lacks the requested copy; Harbour has one available.
scenarios.outcome: The receiving branch confirms arrival before the reader is notified.

steps.title: Register the request
steps.text: Northbank staff check membership and record the reader’s reservation.

steps.title: Find a regional copy
steps.text: Reservations checks the shared catalogue and identifies the Harbour copy.

steps.title: Prepare and deliver
steps.text: Harbour prepares the copy, schedules it and delivers it to Northbank.

steps.title: Confirm and notify
steps.text: Northbank confirms receipt. The notices service sends the pickup message through the gateway.

scenarios.label: The shared foundation
scenarios.summary: Local services depend on common applications and records.
scenarios.condition: All six branches use the shared applications.
scenarios.outcome: The operating team can trace branch dependencies through services to runtime and records.

steps.title: Shared discovery
steps.text: Each collection team searches the same regional catalogue.

steps.title: Common runtime and records
steps.text: The applications share runtime and storage. An interruption here affects several branch activities.
